newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's satanic detective gets five years jail.
newsitem.headline: NZ's satanic detective gets five years jail.

text.p: Disgraced New Zealand detective Brent Garner was sentenced on Friday to five years jail.

Garner, a former detective in the North Island town of Ashurst, was sentenced in the Palmerston North District Court after admitting faking a Satanic attack on himself and burning down his own home to make a false insurance claim.
The former policeman had faced up to 14 years in prison.
The case was originally reported as a horrendous assault on Garner and a miraculous escape.

Early on October 18, Garner spread petrol throughout his home and cut his own back with a scalpel. He then set a timing device, threw petrol over himself, tied a gag over his mouth and tied himself up.
After the home was engulfed in fire, Garner was found near the house, still bound and gagged, with multiple injuries and claiming to have escaped his attackers.

After 37 days of police investigation, Garner admitted he had staged the whole affair. He said he had planned to separate from his wife and wanted to give her a good financial start and ensure his family would be taken care of.
On the charge of arson, Garner will serve three and a half years and another 18 months on charges of forgery, false pretences and making a false statement.
Judge Lynton Lang told Garner that the forgeries were bizarre and cruel to other police.
He said he'd bought significant discredit to police at a time when there was public sympathy for officers because of recent attacks on them.
